fields.label: Address
fields.help: The IP or host name of the Pocket WiFi or Pocket LAN dongle on the network, with :port when it is not 80.
fields.patternMessage: An IP or host name, with :port when it is not 80 - no http:// and no path.

fields.label: Registration number
fields.help: The dongle's local password: its registration number, printed on its label and the name of its own Wi-Fi hotspot, unless it was changed in the SolaX app. An X-Hybrid needs none.

fields.label: Register table
fields.help: Leave on Automatic. Type 14 is read with the Q.VOLT table when the dongle answers 200 registers, and with the X3-Hybrid G4 one otherwise.
